title: succisa pratensis var. glabrata
intro: Succisa pratensis var. glabrata, commonly known as Sticky Meadow Cat's Ear, is a plant species that belongs to the family Valerianaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic to prevent infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include being a natural diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Sticky Meadow Cat's Ear include valerenic acid and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
